title: End-of-year work party for 50 near North Rocks or Holroyd? Eggless 16-inch
summary:

Smaller team? A 14-inch serves 40-45 from $114.99. Send the design, your logo or a screenshot on WhatsApp and we make it in-house.

Fifty people. One cake. No ingredient questions.
